stage_1.assessment: Spec compliance verified against packet DELIVERABLE and Story 3. GET /api/scan/stream emits `event: folder` per onProgress entry with JSON entry data and terminal `event: done` with full {entries,scannedAt,partial} from scanAll. Abort wired via res close -> AbortController -> abortSignal through raceDeadline/scanAll/scanFolder with guarded writes so no done after abort. GET /api/scan handler untouched and existing tests green. SSE writeHead spreads securityHeaders() with text/event-stream, no new deps, no WebSockets. makeEntry unchanged so access_denied/partial keep status+reason. Frame shape event:folder/event:done matches T7 client expectation.

strengths: Real-filesystem fixture (fs.mkdtemp with two dirs) validates headers, folder frames, and done payload entries/partial/scannedAt
Abort test uses hanging readdir stub, asserts readdirCount==1, no event:done after destroy, no uncaught errors, server stays healthy
Abort listener removed in finally, raceDeadline cleans up abort listener and timer, no leak
Security headers reused, fallback preserved, zero deps
stage_2.assessment: Implementation is clean and minimal. Abort plumbing correctly stops further folder work via isAborted checks and deadline race. Res close (vs req close) is functionally equivalent for disconnect detection and listener is removed. All 32 server tests pass including both new stream tests and CSP/fallback coverage.
